deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: No Ambient Authority / Zero Standing Privilege
deltas.rationale: Capability/authority separation did not explicitly deny ambient model, network, filesystem, process, state, secret, read and effect authority.
deltas.nonClaim: No proof that all future capability surfaces have already been inventoried.

deltas.existingRule: CM-CAN-08 enforcement at the effect boundary
deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: Complete Mediation of Meaningful Boundary Crossings
deltas.rationale: Effect-only wording is too narrow for reads, model traffic, secrets, network, Mind, skills and process crossings.
deltas.nonClaim: Mediation covers defined interfaces, not every internal instruction or unknown side channel.

deltas.existingRule: Agent is not an authority boundary in its own right
deltas.rationale: A product boundary must be independent of OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Docker or another individual mechanism.
deltas.nonClaim: No universal adapter equivalence or compatibility claim.

deltas.existingRule: Gateway-only OpenClaw Docker language in local proof and public issues
deltas.rationale: Gateway-only routing without kernel, hypervisor or OS enforcement is a convention and cannot establish isolation.
deltas.nonClaim: The existing Docker proof remains valid for its exact local adapter scope.

deltas.existingRule: CM-CAN-02 Owner-rooted Profile and Administration section
deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: typed default-off Profiles with owner-selectable full control
deltas.rationale: The Owner may select broad authority, but full control must remain explicit, typed, mediated, revocable and isolated rather than ambient.
deltas.nonClaim: Full control does not mean bypass authority or unconstrained host access.

deltas.existingRule: CM-CAN-08/09 trusted effect boundary and credential custody
deltas.rationale: Decision, Policy, model routing, secret use, effects, Evidence and emergency controls must not collapse into the Agent.
deltas.nonClaim: Logical separation is not automatically independent-failure isolation; co-deployment remains in the TCB.

deltas.rationale: Requests, responses, streams, attachments, structured output and tool candidates require separate deterministic guards.
deltas.nonClaim: No live-provider, universal protocol or injection-elimination claim.

deltas.existingRule: Credentials outside planning; no general durable state law
deltas.rationale: Durable Agent state needs tenant, purpose, data class, provenance, retention, quota, reset and recovery semantics.
deltas.nonClaim: No production durability, backup, encryption-custody, privacy-compliance or disaster-recovery claim.

deltas.existingRule: CM-CAN-03 and CM-CAN-15 admission/installation do not activate authority
deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: governed skill lifecycle, capability discovery and JIT quarantine
deltas.rationale: Skills need distinct discovery, admission, install, activation, update, rollback and quarantine transitions; JIT hooks may only tighten.
deltas.nonClaim: AAS-037 is design-only at 0/6; no implemented skill lifecycle is claimed.

deltas.existingRule: CM-CAN-11 fail closed and CM-CAN-12 reconciliation
deltas.rationale: Safety depends on explicit liveness/readiness, partition, timeout, durable state, reset and recovery behavior without direct-path fallback.
Accountability should expose defined boundary facts and limitations while avoiding unnecessary prompts, outputs, secrets and personal data.
deltas.nonClaim: No complete internal model thought or hidden-state transparency.

deltas.existingRule: informal development state distinct from alignment and fitness
deltas.rationale: Voluntary maturity labels may aid operators only when bound to exact Agent, adapter, version, configuration, threat model and environment.
deltas.nonClaim: Maturity is not certification, admission or transfer to untested Agents/adapters/environments.

deltas.existingRule: Docker-specific current Architecture and demo guidance
deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: Docker as Reference Adapter, not normative product principle
deltas.rationale: The local Docker E2E remains real evidence while the product permits VM/MicroVM, WASM, remote worker or equivalent OS sandbox adapters.
deltas.nonClaim: No current proof for non-Docker adapters.

deltas.existingRule: No explicit TCB and side-channel claim ceiling
deltas.newSecurityPrinciple: explicit TCB, bypass and side-channel boundaries
deltas.rationale: Isolation claims must expose dependence on identity, Policy, brokers, secret/state/evidence services, runtime control plane, OS/kernel/hypervisor and environment.
deltas.nonClaim: No resistance claim against a compromised TCB or unknown covert channel.
